storage.title: Storage Usage
storage.info:
Local storage is limited to 5 MB total, and this is shared by every app on this site. Each database stored will take up some space, and the currently active database will take additional space.

If you are nearing the storage limit, data may fail to save or may get erased without warning.
storage.warning: You are near the local storage limit, data may fail to save or may get erased without warning.
